report.summary: Recognizable and coherent miniature: the low brown-brick block, restrained flat parapet, pale-framed dark entrance, blue AT&T plaque, small right-side opening, and two offset rooftop boxes capture the supplied references. No obvious visible defects or duplicate principal portals are present.
